notes: «وقال مسدد» opens a second isnad for the same saying (rule 4): a second group, not a variant, since it carries the same report
«يعلى» (occurrence 2) is the Companion who says «ليتني أرى رسول الله» and whose account is the report; occurrence 1 is inside «صفوان بن يعلى بن أمية», so the count is by the word in the text
the Prophet is the end of the chain, not a link; the editor's «ح»-like marker «عطاء،‏.‏» ends the first isnad with no separate convergence
